title: GenerateFillResult
description: One candidate's result blob for the two-sided capabilities, `generate.inpaint` and `generate.transition` (specs/09-generation.md §4.3–4.4, §6). Like `GenerateExtendResult`, but the audio is spliced at both ends: `startOffsetSamples` is where the processed audio starts relative to the gap start (the `before` context's end), `endOffsetSamples` where it ends relative to the gap end (the `after` context's start). Uploaded as `blobs.candidate_<index>` next to `assets.candidate_<index>`.

passed.description: Every non-skipped gate passed at both seams.

seamScore.description: Seam score at the start splice (into the gap); null when it could not be scored.

endSeamScore.description: Seam score at the end splice (out of the gap); null when it could not be scored.

startOffsetSamples.description: Start of the processed audio relative to the gap start; negative = inside the `before` overlap.

endOffsetSamples.description: End of the processed audio relative to the gap end; positive = inside the `after` overlap.
